scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run check && npm --prefix backend run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run deploy:backend
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && wrangler deploy
